body.segment: This paper continues the design considerations of a novel type of passive filter called hybrid LC filter (HLCF).
The filter is aimed at significant reduction in high-frequency differential mode (DM) and common mode (CM) currents in speed-controlled ac drives.
A model of the HLCF is presented.
Based on the model, a transfer function of the HLCF is found.
The HLCF behavior is analyzed in frequency domain.
A method for HLCF frequency-domain behavior estimation with asymptotes is proposed.
A comparison of the measured, simulated, and calculated results in frequency domain is presented.
